messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Elevated 5xx rate detected for customer: Sidereal (dedicated cluster eu-west1). Affected route: /v1/models/model-reranker-v2/generate. 5m window: 15% 5xx, spike started ~5743219600. Alert: https://monitoring.internal/alerts/ALRT-5743
oncall-tash: Taking pager. I'll triage now.
emma (SRE): seeing grpc DEADLINE_EXCEEDED from model shard pool; errors from worker nodes id 12-14. Logs: `rpc_stream: closed with code=13` on several backends.
devon (eng-runtime): any recent runtime rollouts? I pushed a kernel selection tweak last night to reduce latency for long prompts.
emma (SRE): yeah that change landed 5743180000, but traffic didn't hit it until autoscaler rotated nodes earlier today. Reproducing locally with 50 concurrent short requests -> kv cache miss causes retries.
devon (eng-runtime): rolling back kernel tweak to previous selector. Doing a staged rollback to 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Will post progress.
nina (CSM): flagging Sidereal CSM: Maria Lopez (external). They have active payments flow hitting the reranker every 2s; this will likely affect their reconciliation. Need tailored customer comm asap.
alex (Product): prioritize status page + a direct customer email. Keep wording tight: what happened, who affected, mitigation, ETA. Also include contact routing for Sidereal's emergency contacts.
emma (SRE): rollback at 5743219720 -> 10% traffic. Error rate initial drop to 8%. Continuing rollout.
devon (eng-runtime): 50% at 5743219805. No spike in 5xx for 2m. Proceeding to 100%.
emma (SRE): 100% at 5743219890. Error rate back to baseline ~0.5%. Monitoring for 10m.
kate (OpsLead): thanks. Preparing internal handoff notes for the night oncall.
nina (CSM): drafting Sidereal message below — can everyone quick review? I want to send from CSM + Ops.
--- DRAFT CUSTOMER EMAIL ---
```
Subject: Incident: Intermittent request failures affecting Sidereal model reranking (eu-west1)

Hi Maria / Sidereal ops team,

We wanted to let you know about a short incident that affected your Sidereal-dedicated inference cluster in eu-west1 on <timestamp>. Between ~5743219600 and 5743219890 UTC some requests to the model-reranker-v2 endpoint experienced elevated 5xx errors, which may have impacted reconciliation and payments pipelines that query rearranking results.

What happened
- A runtime kernel selector update interacted poorly with our worker autoscale rotation, causing transient RPC timeouts and retries.

Customers affected
- Sidereal (all accounts on the dedicated eu-west1 cluster). Impacted routes: `/v1/models/model-reranker-v2/generate` (reranking).

Mitigation and current state
- We rolled back the runtime selector change and validated full traffic routing to the previous stable variant at 5743219890 UTC. Error rates have returned to baseline and we are monitoring.

Next steps
- Postmortem with timeline and root cause analysis within 2 business days.
- Optional: We can schedule a follow-up call with your engineering team to review impact and compensating controls.

Emergency contacts
- Primary: Maria Lopez (Sidereal CSM) — [on your side]
- Redwood on-call: +44 20 555 0188 (pager via Ops) and incident channel: #incidents (internal)

Sorry for the disruption — we know how important the reranker is for your flows.

Best,
Nina (CSM) + Redwood Ops
```
--- END DRAFT ---
marco (Legal): wording looks fine. Keep the promise of a 2 business day postmortem. Avoid speculation about data loss (none detected).
alex (Product): one tweak: explicitly list the ETA for full recovery (already recovered) and the monitoring window. Add a short status page blurb.
nina (CSM): updated draft pushed below. Ready to send once Ops confirms full recovery for 30m.
--- STATUS PAGE ENTRY (proposed) ---
```
Summary: Intermittent request failures affecting Sidereal's dedicated eu-west1 reranker endpoint.
Impact: Short-lived 5xx errors for requests to `/v1/models/model-reranker-v2/generate` between 5743219600 and 5743219890 UTC. Some Sidereal payment/reconciliation calls may have failed or retried.
Current Status: Mitigated — rollback completed and traffic restored to stable variant at 5743219890 UTC. Monitoring in progress.
Next Update: Postmortem within 2 business days.
```
--- END STATUS ---
emma (SRE): confirm 30m stable window ends at 5743221690. If all good I'll mark resolved and close the incident.
nina (CSM): sending tailored notice to Maria now (cc'ing ops).
oncall-tash: handing to night oncall: @oncall-lee for continued monitoring. Full handoff notes:
- Incident start: 5743219600 (alerted by incident-bot)
- Root cause: runtime kernel selector interaction with node rotation -> transient RPC timeouts
- Action taken: staged rollback completed 5743219890 UTC
- Postmortem ETA: 2 business days
- Customer comm: sent to Sidereal primary contact (Maria).

kate (OpsLead): leaving an internal comm template in case of follow-ups:
```
Internal note for account teams:
- Affected account: Sidereal (dedicated eu-west1)
- Impact: short-lived 5xx to reranker route; possible retry/failure on payment reconciliation flows
- Who to contact: Nina (CSM), Emma (SRE), Devon (eng-runtime)
- Next steps: monitor, include timeline in postmortem, share mitigation recommendations (pin model version, increase KV cache warmup)
```
emma (SRE): 30m stable window complete at 5743221690. No regression observed. Marking incident resolved.
incident-bot: Incident 5743219876 status -> RESOLVED by emma (SRE) at 5743221700.
alex (Product): great work — please file RCA and include the kernel selector test harness failing case.
marco (Legal): please attach the customer comm copy to the incident record.
kate (OpsLead): closing thread, will attach handoff notes to the incident ticket. :white_check_mark:
